meta.name: internal-comms
meta.description: A set of resources to help me write all kinds of internal communications, using the formats that my company likes to use. Claude should use this skill whenever asked to write some sort of internal communications (status reports, leadership updates, 3P updates, company newsletters, FAQs, incident reports, project updates, etc.).

copy.tagline: 按公司模板撰写各类内部通知与报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常需写公司内部邮件、周报或事故报告。
copy.tagline_en: Write internal memos and reports using company templates.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often write internal emails, status reports, or incident reports.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 当你要写内部沟通文档时，Claude 会按照你公司常用的格式来写，比如状态报告、领导层更新、3P 更新、公司通讯、常见问题解答、事故报告、项目更新等。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 写内部沟通文档时触发，例如状态报告、领导层更新、3P 更新、公司通讯等。

say.text: 帮我写一份本周的3P更新。
say.note: Claude 会加载3P更新模板并生成内容。

say.text: 写一份公司通讯稿，宣布新项目启动。
say.note: Claude 会使用公司通讯模板。

say.text: 整理一份常见问题解答，关于新政策。

howto.what_en: When you need to write internal communications, Claude will use your company's preferred formats to produce documents such as status reports, leadership updates, 3P updates, company newsletters, FAQs, incident reports, project updates, etc.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to write internal communications like status reports, leadership updates, 3P updates, company newsletters, etc.

say_en.text: Write a 3P update for this week.
Draft a company newsletter announcing a new project.
Create an FAQ about the new policy.
